newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares rise, buoyed by foreign markets.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares rise, buoyed by foreign markets.

text.p: 1725 GMT - Portuguese shares rose, with the PSI-20 index of 20 leading shares up 5.7 percent on the week, buoyed by the strength of foreign markets. Dealers noted heavy buying interest in banks, notably Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor and Banco Comercial Portugues. Sonae Investimentos hit an all-time high of 5,930 escudos on its last day of trade before the restructuring of the group into two companies. Portugal Telecom shares closed weaker on profit taking, dealers said.

* Dealers said they expected a calm session on Monday ahead of Tuesday's Carnival holiday. "I think Monday will be a pause before Carnival and I don't know if this holiday will affect the rest of the week as many investors could take time off," said one operator.
